name: Hyprland
description: Hyprland is an independent, highly customizable, dynamic tiling Wayland compositor that doesn't sacrifice on its looks.
one_liner: A good-looking, highly customizable window manager for Linux desktops — eye candy and control for people who live in a terminal.
buyer: Honestly, mostly individual Linux enthusiasts customizing their own free machine — there is no real business buyer here.
business_use_cases: A Linux-focused YouTuber uses it as the backdrop for 'rice my desktop' videos that earn ad revenue and sponsorships — the content is the business, not the tool.
A boutique Linux-laptop reseller ships it preconfigured as a visual differentiator against stock Ubuntu or GNOME installs.
A systems administrator standardizes it across a dev team's workstations purely for consistency, not resale.

money_ideas.idea: Sell pre-themed configuration bundles or paid 'ricing' packs to enthusiasts.

steal_this: Package a polished, zero-config Hyprland theme and sell it for a few dollars to the ricing community — a fun weekend project, not a business.
